title: Encasing LAMP Mixture in Paraffin
author: Niels Appelman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jbhuin

steps.title: Prepare 10X primer mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10X primer mix according to the described scheme.

steps.title: Add components to tube
steps.instruction: Add the listed components to a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Dry LAMP mixture
steps.instruction: Open the centrifuge tube and dry at 37 °C until only solid remains. Note: longer drying reduces enzyme activity; use low‑humidity storage or lyophilisation to speed up.

steps.title: Add paraffin wax
steps.instruction: Add 4 mg of paraffin wax to the dried LAMP mixture.

steps.title: Melt wax and encapsulate
steps.instruction: Heat at 60 °C for 5 minutes to melt the wax and encapsulate the dried LAMP mixture.

steps.title: Add activity‑test reagents
steps.instruction: After the wax has dried, add the specified components to test continued enzyme activity.

steps.title: Record color result
steps.instruction: Record the color of each sample; yellow indicates a positive result.

steps.title: Confirm doubtful results
steps.instruction: If results are uncertain, run the sample on an agarose gel; a smear of many indistinct bands indicates a positive result.
